title: Golden calcite alabaster altar of unknown origin

tellings.quote: that altar in front of you is made out of golden kisite Alabaster right and they don't even know where it came from

plain: An ancient altar in the Lake Van region of Turkey is said to be carved from golden calcite alabaster, a soft, glowing yellow stone, and no one knows where the stone came from. The researcher Matt LaCroix says this to Jesse Michels while describing the site, without naming a source. If true, the stone's unknown origin would add to the mystery of who built the site and how.
